knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson states that the add-on gives knowledge only and grants no licence, certificate or authority.

practicalCriteria: Assessor asks the candidate to state, in one sentence, what the add-on does not grant, and the candidate does so without any licence claim
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate. Completing the add-on grants no licence.
evidenceRequired: Assessor note on any licence or authority claim made by the candidate
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate states or implies that completing the add-on gives a licence number or authority
